name: Honasa Consumer Ltd.
about: Honasa Consumer Limited operates as a digital beauty and personal care company in India and internationally. The company provides baby care, skin and hair care, color cosmetics, other related personal care products, as well as beauty salon and hair styling services. It sells in products under the Mamaearth, The Derma Co., BBlunt, Aqualogica, Lumineve, Reginald Men, Molecular, Staze, and Dr. Sheth's brands through online and offline stores. The company was formerly known as Honasa Consumer Private Limited and changed its name to Honasa Consumer Limited in November 2022. Honasa Consumer Limited was incorporated in 2016 and is based in Gurugram, India.

verdict.label: Looks expensive
reasons: Price implies ~32% a year profit growth for 10 years, versus ~17% that history and analysts support (reverse DCF at 10.8% cost of equity).
PE of 59 is near the bottom of its range over the last 3 years (median 123), though that is a short history to judge by.
Trades at PE 59 vs sector median 41; peers with similar ROCE and growth trade nearer 42, so the premium is not explained by fundamentals alone.
Since 2024, the price gain has been earned: earnings grew 45% a year while PE moved 129 → 59.
